description:
## Finding

Two functions returning `Result` are missing `# Errors` doc sections. Clippy: `clippy::missing_errors_doc`.

## Locations

```
pkix-path/tests/pkits_helper.rs:64

pub fn pkits_validate(cert_names: &[&str], now_unix: u64) -> pkix_path::Result<ValidatedPath> {
```

This is a test helper and not part of any public API, so adding a `# Errors` section is opinion-territory. The lint fires because `pub` extends across the crate boundary in a binary `[[test]]` target.

```
pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:121

pub fn validate_attribute_cert(
    _ac: &AttributeCertificate,
    _aa_anchors: &[pkix_path::TrustAnchor],
    ...
) -> Result<()> {
    Err(Error::NoTrustedSct)
}
```

This one is genuine public API of the `pkix-ac` stub. It needs a `# Errors` section explaining all error variants returned.

## Priority

P4 — the pkix-ac stub has a real doc gap (and is `pub`, advertised, etc.). The test helper case is a non-issue.
title: P4: pkix-ac validate_attribute_cert pub fn missing # Errors doc section
